responsibility: Implements middle-end-only regimplification helpers that repair or force trees into valid GIMPLE operands outside the main front-end lowering pass. Its force_gimple_operand* routines expand an arbitrary tree into a statement sequence plus a value satisfying a requested gimple_predicate, optionally inserting the generated code at a gimple_stmt_iterator, while gimple_regimplify_operands walks an existing statement’s operands and regimplifies invalid lvalues, rvalues, call targets, switch indices, asm operands, and related forms after transformations such as inlining have broken strict GIMPLE operand rules.
same_name_distinction: Implements the middle-end regimplification helpers used after the main lowering pass to repair individual operands or statements; unlike gcc/gimplify.cc, which performs full front-end-to-GIMPLE lowering, and unlike gcc/gimplify-me.h, which only declares this repair API, this file provides the post-gimplification fixup logic.
